messages:
Asha Patel: Quick async check — SynergyCo renewal is next Tue. We saw a webhook delivery regression yesterday after the retry backoff tweak. CS picked up ~2% failed callbacks between 23:10–23:25 UTC. Can eng peek at logs? cc @Liam Chen @Ben Kline
Liam Chen: On it. Do you have example request IDs or a sample payload/time window?
Asha Patel: Yep, sample ID: 03f9d-7f2a-4b2c. They got a bunch of 502/timeout responses from their firewall. I pasted a sample delivery attempt below:```curl -v -H "X-Request-ID: 03f9d-7f2a-4b2c" -H "X-Signature: sha256=abc..." -d '{"order":123}' https://hooks.synergyco.example.com/callback```
Asha Patel: From CS notes: failures clustered after we rolled retry exponent to 2.5 — likely caused spike of parallel retries to their endpoint. They use a pretty strict concurrent connection limit.
Ben Kline: Thanks. Short-term mitigation: revert retry exponent to 1.5 for webhook delivery for that customer or route their callbacks through the low-concurrency fallback queue. Can someone confirm we still have the previous config?
Priya Rao: FYI SynergyCo will be sensitive to any downtime this week (renewal discussions). If we can show a mitigation and a postmortem before EOD Friday that helps.
Liam Chen: I can run a targeted rollback for just SynergyCo. @Ben Kline — can you share the command to flip them back to the previous retry profile?
Ben Kline: Yup — for config-service:```PATCH /v1/customers/synergyco/config {"webhook_retry_exponent":1.5}``` Will push via canary (100% for that customer id only). I'll open a quick PR and tag the deploy.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: PR #3421 by Ben Kline -> canary-target: customer=synergyco. ETA: ~8m
Liam Chen: I'll tail the delivery logs after deploy. Path: /var/logs/webhooks/delivery/YYYY/MM/DD (filtered by X-Request-ID). Will also watch the queue lengths on the fallback path.
Asha Patel: Thanks team. Also saw a note about embedding similarity drift in their search rerank tests after we switched model variant last month — that might be compounding adoption concerns. Could we verify embeddings model for their tenant (should be pinned to embed-v1-stable)?
Ben Kline: I'll check tenant model pinning. If drift happened we can roll them back to embed-v1-stable and re-run the eval set.
Priya Rao: Perfect. I'll update SynergyCo: immediate short-term rollback + next steps to verify embeddings. Will ask for logs they can share from their firewall too.
Liam Chen: After deploy I see delivery retry exponent set back to 1.5 for customer=synergyco. Initial backlog drained, error rate dropped to ~0.1% in the last 5m. :thumbsup:
Asha Patel: Awesome — please paste the final SLAs we used so I can include in the customer note. Also schedule a quick postmortem doc for Friday (owners: Liam, Ben).
Ben Kline: Will open postmortem draft, assign owners.
Asha Patel: Thanks all — I'll send an update to the account team and sync with renewal lead.
Priya Rao: Thanks!
Liam Chen: Closing the loop once postmortem is in.
